trigger: an operator reads the Compliance actions table on a build where /static/yuzu-dialog.js is not shipped
summary: The row said the New policy / New fragment controls are "Hidden when the shared dialog script is unavailable", which is true but leaves the operator hunting for two controls that cannot appear on this build. FIXED IN 79c012ef5: the row states the controls are not available in this build and names the REST create routes (POST /api/policies, POST /api/policy-fragments, both verified in policy_admin_routes.cpp).
classification_rationale: a required operator-manual statement (item 2) that did not say the control is unreachable

trigger: session expires, viewer clicks Refresh or View on a fragment panel
summary: The 401 -> /login branch added in 38406637a is unreachable for fragment GETs: the pre-routing chokepoint (server.cpp ~14869-14882) answers a session-less non-/api/ path with a 302 to /login, XHR follows it, and htmx swaps the login page into the panel with no error event. Verified by reading the chokepoint and the bundled htmx 2.0.4 beforeSwap path. FIXED IN 3af6b775e: an htmx:beforeSwap handler checks xhr.responseURL, cancels the swap and navigates to /login; the 401 branch stays for routes that answer 401 themselves; the page pin test pins the handler.
classification_rationale: the commit message and comment claimed a 401 goes to login, which was not true for the path the page uses

trigger: htmx:timeout fires on a slow but reachable server
summary: "Could not reach the server" was shown for htmx:timeout, where the server was reached. FIXED IN 3af6b775e: timeout has its own wording ("taking too long to answer").
classification_rationale: user-visible string asserting something the code path does not establish

trigger: a very large fleet where the per-policy summary render exceeds 30 s
summary: htmx.config.timeout = 30000 is unmeasured against the summary render at the large-fleet target (up to 100 sequential per-policy reads plus a full-table aggregate); a slow healthy render would be reported as slow and each Refresh queues another. Tracked in #5794.
classification_rationale: no measurement exists for the chosen bound

trigger: a transient failure on the fragments or tag-compliance panel
summary: Only the summary panel has a Refresh control; #policy-fragments and #tag-compliance load once, so "Try Refresh" is not actionable there until a page reload. Wording is inherited from the old 5xx branch. Tracked in #5794.
classification_rationale: a note that promises a control two of the panels do not have

summary: /fragments/devices/list renders an empty roster when api_ is null, the same defect class this change fixes for Compliance. Out of this diff. The seam is built unconditionally in production (server.cpp:17649, make_local_device_api passed at :17711), so the wrong outcome cannot occur there (E6). Reported independently by security-guardian and consistency-auditor. Tracked in #5793.
classification_rationale: an empty result presented as a healthy answer on a wiring fault

trigger: someone remaps a 403 to the generic note
summary: The page pin test pinned the 401 redirect but nothing pinned a 403 to the panel data-denied note, nor the sendError message. FIXED IN 3af6b775e: pins for st === 403 ? null and both messages.
classification_rationale: missing pin for a behaviour the change keeps

trigger: a test comment cites a branch that no longer exists
summary: The comment referred to "the old 401 || 403 branch", history that goes stale. FIXED IN 3af6b775e.

trigger: a reader looks for the fragment by PR number
summary: The fragment name carries no PR number or date prefix. Not touched by this diff, the lint accepts it, and renaming it would churn a file the reviewer already read.

trigger: a null seam on the detail fragment
summary: The detail null-seam note reads "(store degraded)" where the REST twin says "not available". Deliberate: the detail reuses its existing degraded renderer rather than a second note, and the dashboard convention is a 200 with a note (htmx drops 4xx bodies).
classification_rationale: message parity only; the outcome (honest degrade, no audit row) is the same
